description: This file contains the implementation of utility functions related to Event-Condition-Action (ECA) rules for services in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles loading, merging, and executing ECA rules associated with services, including configuration reading and rule management.

classes.name: ServiceEcaUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing methods to manage Service ECA rules, including configuration loading, rule merging, and evaluation.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Clears the ECA cache and reloads the configuration.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Loads ECA rules from configuration files and component resources into the cache.

methods.name: addEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Adds new ECA definitions to the cache from a ResourceHandler.

methods.name: getEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Parses a ResourceHandler's XML document to extract ECA rules as ServiceEcaRule objects.

methods.name: mergeEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Merges a list of ServiceEcaRules into the cache, replacing duplicates.

methods.name: getServiceEventMap
methods.description: Retrieves the map of event rules for a specific service.

methods.name: getServiceEventRules
methods.description: Retrieves the list of rules for a specific service and event.

methods.name: evalRules
methods.description: Evaluates and executes ECA rules for a given service and event, handling provided context and results.
